{{translated title}} ---- (Japanese: '''{{j|カウントダウンポケモンデー}}''' ''Countdown Pokémon Day'') is a [[Pokémon manga]] written by {{j|松村和盛}} ''Kazumori Matsumura'' and illustrated by {{j|花村ヤソ}} ''Yaso Hanamura''. It was published daily on [[Poké Times]] from February 20 to 27, 2025, in celebration of [[Pokémon Day#2025|Pokémon Day 2025]]. ==Characters== * '''Yūsuke''' (Japanese: '''{{j|ユウスケ}}''' ''Yūsuke''). He is the Pokémon Day Executive Committee Leader. He owns a {{p|Scraggy}}. * '''Daichi''' (Japanese: '''{{j|ダイチ}}''' ''Daichi''). He is a Pokémon Day Executive Committee member. He owns a {{p|Machamp}}. * '''Tokio''' (Japanese: '''{{j|トキオ}}''' ''Tokio''). He is a Pokémon Day Executive Committee member. He owns a {{p|Gardevoir}}. * '''Umina''' (Japanese: '''{{j|ウミナ}}''' ''Umina''). She is a Pokémon Day Executive Committee member. She owns a {{p|Slowpoke}} named '''Yadoyan''' (Japanese: '''{{j|ヤドやん}}''' ''Yadoyan''). * '''Yuki''' (Japanese: '''{{j|ユキ}}''' ''Yuki''). She is a Pokémon Day Executive Committee member. She owns a {{p|Ludicolo}} named '''Run-chan''' (Japanese: '''{{j|ルンちゃん}}''' ''Run-chan''). * '''Ai''' (Japanese: '''{{j|アイ}}''' ''Ai''). She is Yūsuke's senior. She owns a {{p|Gyarados}} named '''Gyara-chan''' (Japanese: '''{{j|ギャラちゃん}}''' ''Gyara-chan''). * '''Mayor''' (Japanese: '''{{j|市長}}''' ''Mayor''). He owns a {{p|Braviary}}. ===Gallery===
